split_unit: whole campaign and one PID incarnation
selection_policy: Maximize onset-qualified tuning campaign recall at a cutoff immediately above the largest benign tuning session maximum; tie-break fewer false alerts, then smaller mean onset-to-alert event delay among detected tuning campaigns, then fewer tree nodes.
cutoff_policy: After selecting one estimator, use the next representable float above the largest benign calibration session maximum. Clip at1 only at the score ceiling, explicitly reporting an unattainable zero-alert budget. Never adjust after opening test.
retired_evidence: v1 test and HTTP default-worker failures are diagnostic development evidence, not untouched evidence for v2.
limitations: All operation variants and three content profiles occur in development. Structured profile and fresh seeds are held out, but share worker templates and fixture grammars; no independent malware-family or production generalization claim.
